secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials -> OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Web application). Needed for Google sign-in; without it the Google button stays disabled.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret of the same Google OAuth 2.0 client (starts with GOCSPX-).

secrets.name: FACEBOOK_APP_ID
secrets.description: Meta for Developers -> your app -> App settings -> Basic -> App ID. Needed for Facebook sign-in.

secrets.name: FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Meta for Developers -> your app -> App settings -> Basic -> App secret (click Show).
